7:- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approve the actions that spend credits
82:- [host-compat](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/host-compat.md): API reference for @mcpjam/sdk/host-compat — derive server requirements, evaluate host compatibility, and scan widget bridge usage.
92:- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.
125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
129:- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
144:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.
147:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.
203:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
241:- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.
245:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.
295:- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…
321:- [Send one agent Playground message](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): Send one message to a project's MCP servers and get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation could not see: which tools ran, with what arguments, what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.
323:- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-trace.md): Per-turn execution spans: per-tool-call latency, token usage, and indices into the transcript. Same span shape as the eval iteration trace.
